lines.2: 「Oh dear, what we do? Mana should wake him.」
lines.5: 「Oh, Kinu. See, we have cleaning duty, but Date is asleep...」
lines.6: 「Oh, so this delinquent's in the way and you can't move the desks. Just wake him up.」
lines.7: 「But Date little scary. He look so peaceful sleeping, even harder to wake.」
lines.8: 「He's Date, the guy who shuts crying kids right up. If the Princess were here, we'd ask her to do it.」
lines.9: 「Hey, wake up. Your trashy ass is in the way of our cleaning.」
lines.11: 「Wake up or I'll rip out that annoying hair of yours.」
lines.17: 「Now get your ass to your club. You're in the way.」
lines.19: 「Ow! Quit kicking me, quit it! All right, I'm going!」
lines.22: 「Nothing looks more ridiculous than an idiot putting on airs.」
lines.24: Grr. Something about that reaction really ticks me off.
lines.25: 「All right, how about we go shopping?」
lines.27: 「Aw, come on. Let's blow it off just this once.」
lines.28: 「No. With you, 'just this once' would drag on forever.」
lines.29: 「You just wanna ogle the Princess, you closet perv.」
lines.31: 「What the hell? That hurt. Don't push me.」
lines.33: 「Hey! I didn't even push you that hard!」
lines.38: 「Fightin' again? You two sure do get along.」
lines.44: 「Look--they're practically shoving each other right now.」
lines.46: 「...Th-that was a joke. No, they're not going out. Seriously.」
lines.48: 「They're always like that, so it's hard to tell where they stand.」
lines.53: 「Man... Why won't somebody come flying into my arms?」
lines.59: 「Don't cry over a little thing like that.」
lines.60: 「I-I'm not crying! I'm not crying, okay?!」
lines.61: 「Then I'll shove you one last time and grind the taste of defeat into you. Here I come.」
lines.62: 「Grr... Bring it! I'll take you down with me!」
lines.68: 「Tsushima went flying and crashed right into Fukahire!」
lines.69: 「What were you thinking, shoving a girl?」
lines.71: 「Why the hell did YOU have to come flying into my arms?!」
lines.75: Inori already seemed to be wilting in the summer heat.
lines.81: 「Hah! Idiot! Don't act tough when you're such a wimp.」
lines.83: 「Phew. Some things you just have to settle with your own two hands, or they keep eating at you.」
lines.84: 「I admire the spirit... but everyone is staring at you in disbelief.」
lines.85: 「Oh, these fights are business as usual.」
lines.86: 「They're practically a class tradition. Even I leave them be.」
lines.87: 「When enough people are around, some of them even bet on who'll win.」
lines.88: 「Discipline is remarkably poor for the class that contains the student council president.」
lines.89: 「Well, the student council president joins the betting too.」
lines.90: 「...It will likely be wasted effort, but as her senior, I shall lecture the Princess later.」
lines.91: 「For now, Kanisawa, clean up this mess.」
lines.93: 「Damn it. Why am I the one who gets stuck with this?」
lines.95: 「Quit sweeping me with the broom! I'm not garbage!」
